en: The octopus lives deep ___ the sea.
The octopus is inside the water, so it lives in the sea.
There is snow ___ top of the mountain.
The snow sits on top of the mountain.
The mouse hides ___ the bed, with the bed above it.
The bed is above the mouse, so the mouse is under it.
Mia sits ___ her two friends, one on each side.
When something is in the middle of two things, it is between them.
The tree is ___ the house, so you cannot see it from the front.
The house is in front and blocks it, so the tree is behind the house.
The two puppies sleep ___ each other, side by side.
Side by side means next to each other.
The letter B comes ___ A and C.
B is in the middle of A and C, so it is between them.
Put your books ___ your bag and zip it up.
The books go inside the bag, so they go in it.
The sun is hiding ___ a big cloud.
The cloud is in front of the sun, so the sun is behind it.
We stand ___ the umbrella to stay dry.
The umbrella is above us, so we stand under it.
The owl is sitting ___ a branch.
The owl is on top of the branch, so it sits on it.
The milk is ___ the fridge, so it stays cold.
The milk is inside the fridge, so it is in it.
The shoes are ___ the bed, so you must look down low to find them.
The bed is above the shoes, so they are under it.
The letter M comes ___ L and N.
M is in the middle of L and N, so it is between them.
The car is parked ___ the house, where you cannot see it from the street.
The house blocks the view from the front, so the car is behind it.
The plate holds the cake up, so the cake is on it.
My little brother sits ___ me on the bus, in the seat beside me.
Beside me means next to me.
The key is locked away ___ the box.
The key is inside the box, so it is in it.
A cherry sits ___ top of the cake.
The cherry is on top of the cake.
Hide ___ the tree so nobody on the path can see you.
The tree is in front of you and hides you, so you are behind it.
2 is in the middle of 1 and 3, so it is between them.
The teddy sits ___ the doll on the shelf, side by side.
Side by side means next to each other.
The rabbit digs a burrow deep ___ the ground, below the grass.
The burrow is below the grass, so it is under the ground.
The bee rests on top of the flower, so it lands on it.
The ball rolled ___ the sofa, and now it is stuck below it.
The ball is below the sofa, so it is under it.
The goldfish swims ___ its bowl of water.
The goldfish is inside the bowl, so it swims in it.
The hedgehog curls up ___ a pile of leaves, hidden inside it.
The hedgehog is inside the pile, so it is in it.
Wednesday is in the middle of Tuesday and Thursday, so it is between them.
The giraffe stands ___ the zebra, right beside it.
Snow lies ___ the roof of the house.
The snow rests on top of the roof, so it lies on it.

example.q_en: The octopus lives deep ___ the sea.
example.why_en: The octopus is inside the water, so it lives in the sea.

en.title: Where is it?
en.teach: Some little words tell us where things are: in, on, under, behind, next to and between. The cup is on the table. The cat is under the table.
